name: Pages
description: Reorder, rotate, extract, delete, merge or split PDF pages, compress or sign a PDF, or turn images into a PDF, on your device.

inputs.label: PDFs and images
inputs.help: Choose PDFs, images or both. Every page and image forms one draggable sequence and stays on this device. PDF pages keep their original size, and the new file keeps the first PDF's document details. Compress and Sign work on the first PDF.

inputs.label: Operation
inputs.help: Compress shrinks a PDF by recompressing its images: text and vector graphics stay as they are, and a digital signature in the PDF stops verifying once the file is saved again. Sign places your signature on a page, with an optional Content Credential or password lock.

inputs.label: Pages
inputs.help: 1-based pages and ranges, for example 1-3,7,10-. Reorder accepts a new sequence such as 3,1-2, or drag the previews. Rotate, Extract and Delete also take a press on a preview. Each comma-separated range becomes a PDF when splitting.

inputs.label: First preview position
inputs.help: View any part of a long page sequence, 30 thumbnails at a time.

inputs.label: Image page size
inputs.help: How pages made from images are sized. A4 and US Letter fit each image inside the page, turned to match the image.

inputs.label: Image margin (mm)
inputs.help: Space around each image on an A4 or US Letter page.

inputs.label: Compression
inputs.help: How hard to compress embedded images. Stronger means smaller files and softer images.

inputs.label: Convert images to greyscale
inputs.help: Drop colour from images for extra savings - useful for scanned text documents.

inputs.label: Signature
inputs.help: Use a transparent PNG/JPEG, upload an image, or paste the output link from the Signature tool.

inputs.label: Drawn signature
inputs.help: Signature strokes drawn directly in this tool.

inputs.label: Signature position in PDF points
inputs.help: Drag the signature on the page preview or enter exact PDF-point coordinates.

inputs.label: Add a Content Credential
inputs.help: Records the signer from the profile when Use my details is on. This is optional provenance, not a regulated e-signature service.

inputs.label: Lock with an open password
inputs.help: The password is requested only when downloading and is never stored in tool state. Locking and Content Credentials cannot be combined because encryption would invalidate the credential.
